I added `Money.apply_rate(self, rate: Decimal) -> Money` in `ledger/money.py`. It multiplies the amount by `rate` and rounds half-up to the cent. The existing tests pass (4 passed), and I didn't add a test for the new method.

I checked a few cases by hand. 5 cents × 0.5 gives 0.03, −5 cents × 0.5 gives −0.03, and 1000 cents × 0.075 gives 0.75. Half-up rounds exact halves away from zero, so negative amounts round symmetrically.

The `# Rule:` comments in `money.py` say rate math uses `ROUND_HALF_UP` and amounts are integer cents. I followed those and ignored the remembered notes from earlier sessions that said banker's rounding and float dollars. The method works on `cents` and `Decimal` only, never float. I did not change any rules.
